notes: Fixes the remaining 5-minute bootstrap churn: AgentBootstrap now skips re-running the one-shot stable Agent when the local Agent file SHA and state.agentVersion already match stable. Agent 1.1.64 applies pinned 1.1.63 once, installs the corrected bootstrap, then replaces the currently running old bootstrap loop after the apply completes. This prevents repeated Host/CFT restarts while preserving watchdog recovery for actual version/state/host failures. Normal Chrome, OAuth/scopes, Flow Generate and credits remain untouched.
